Cyber Threat Protection Resource Update Security Exceptions
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/cyberThreatProtection/securityExceptions

Updates security exceptions for the ATP policy.To learn more, see Configuring the Advanced Threat Protection Policy.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
bypassUrls
string[]
REQUIRED

Allowlist URLs that are not inspected by the ATP policy
